facts.text: Reliance Industries reported record second-quarter FY27 profit of  ₹29,550 crore, up 33.8% year-on-year, as a strong recovery in its oil-to-chemicals business and growth in digital services offset weaker retail earnings. Revenue rose 27.8% to  ₹3,62,268 crore.
